The narrative identifies Conditions B and scope trends. Its references to Table 9 and entries 2–9 of Table 4 appear to be source cross-reference errors; table identities were not silently rewritten in the records.
A separate 5 mmol run was retained with 100 mL DCM, two timed stages, 1.0410 g product, and 83% isolated yield; it was not merged with the 0.2 mmol Table 3 entry 1 experiment.

One ordered two-stage experiment was retained: 1j to isolated 4ja (35%, with 57% NMR recovery of 1j), then acetylation to 4jab (31% overall across both steps). The overall yield was not assigned to the last step alone.
The proposed catalytic interpretation continues as Scheme 3 on page 6 and is classified as mechanism, not an experimental preparation.
